_source: Two sources, and each row says which. The six pre-season friendlies come from the club announcement of 20 July 2026, "Sue's Angels FC Confirm Pre-Season Fixtures" (Supabase articles row art-1784578485992). The League Eight fixtures are transcribed from FA Full-Time, Southern Sunday Football League: league 3545957, season 2026-27 = 709965053, division League Eight = 879497042, read 25 August 2026, and the 1 and 8 November rounds re-read 31 October 2026. The Surrey FA Sunday Lower Junior County Cup first-round tie is transcribed from the county's own draw report, "Cup Report - Surrey FA Sunday Lower Junior County Cup", printed 26 October 2026: tie 20 of 32, Sue's Angels 1st -v- The Station 1st, 15/11/26 10:30. The report names no ground, so the venue is the club's own, which is what being drawn first means. THE KICK-OFF IS THE CLUB'S, NOT THE REPORT'S: the county printed 10:30 as the round's default and the club has confirmed 11:00 at The Reeves, so that is what the site says.
_note:
The schedule was published as a news article rather than entered in the panel, which is why nothing reached the site. (This note used to say the production `fixtures` table was empty. It holds one row, the BPR friendly of 30 August, entered later; the transcribed copy of it loses to the real one on the date-and-clubs identity test in dataset.mjs, which is why the duplicate never showed.) Transcribed here so the build has it. Opponent names use the badge registry's spelling where one exists (Pure Football FC 2.0, Kew Antigua, BPR FC) so the crests resolve; Galacticos Elect, Kingsmeadow United and Brentford Town are new opponents with no badge on file yet.

A row with no `competition` is taken as a pre-season friendly, which is what the six announced in July are. The League Eight rows name their competition, so the same file can hold both and a league fixture is never counted as a friendly - which matters, because pre-season retires itself on the first competitive match of the season rather than on a date.

FA FULL-TIME PUBLISHES THE ROUNDS A FEW WEEKS AHEAD, not the whole season. Nothing here is guessed to fill the rest of the season: an absent fixture is an unpublished fixture, and the site says what is known.
_replaceWhen: Delete this file once the fixtures live in the Supabase `fixtures` table, which the control panel writes to. Until then the club adding a fixture in the panel wins over anything here, row by row, on the date-and-clubs identity test in dataset.mjs.

fixtures.competition: Surrey FA Sunday Lower Junior County Cup

_tbc: A fixture with `tbc: true` is one the league has CONFIRMED but not yet dated. The flag is required rather than inferred from an empty date, because a fixture whose date went missing by accident and one the league has not set yet look identical in the data and are completely different things. The suite holds every undated fixture to carrying it.
_removedFixture: A TRANSCRIBED FIXTURE IS A CLAIM ABOUT WHO IS PLAYING, so when a club stops existing the claim stops being true and the row goes. 18 Oct 2026, Sue's Angels FC v Mousa Mountain FC, League Eight: the club folded on 17 October and the league removed them from the division. The club's own stored row was deleted in Control panel -> Fixtures on 19 October and fixture-cancellations.json retired with it - but this copy was still here, and with nothing left to lose to it came back as a dated match in the past with no score, published under "Played, not yet counted" on the results page as though somebody had forgotten to enter it. Removed rather than cancelled: a cancellation is for a match the club has a row for, and there is no row. Mousa Mountain are still named under the League Eight table, which is `removed` in league-eight-2627.json and a different thing: that is a fact about the division, not about one match.
